phase_3.implementation: Proportional scaling of keyword/specificity/causal boosts by pattern strength

option_3_details.specification: avgPatternStrength / 10 → strengthMultiplier → apply to all boosts

artifacts.commit: 063e3545 - STAGE_A_FIX: Option 3 (Proportional Boosts) - Benchmarked and Rejected

decision_rationale.why_reverted: Regressions on BLND-007 and PD-017 caused by blanket reduction of all pattern boosts
decision_rationale.why_insufficient: Option 3 reduces normal pattern boosts (0.4-0.6x) uniformly, reversing existing confidence orderings
decision_rationale.why_no_new_fixes: Base confidences and other factors overwhelm the differentiation from proportional scaling
